subject: (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'

messages.author: 8aa1519cb0a64f4f
messages.subject: (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
parts:
Hello I've been trying to see the surface difference between two frequency spectra and my script returns the following error:

Error in diffspec(specA, specA, f = 44100) : (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'  (I'm comparing the same two files just to test it)

The audio file is a  .wav file imported with the readWave function. Then I constructed the spectogram for the file this way:

> specA<-spectro(A1, f=44100, wl=512, ovlp=70, collevels=seq (-30,0,0.5), osc=FALSE,

+         palette=spectro.colors, colgrid="black", colwave="black", colaxis="black",

+         collab="black", colbg="white",alab = "",flim=c(1,12))

I would appreciate your help

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double'
parts:
Hello,
This is because you make the confusion between a spectrogram
(short-term Fourier transform) and a spectrum (discrete Fourier
transform).
The function diffspec requires the result of the functions spec() or
meanspec().

HTH

Jerome
